stem: A drying-room deviation affected only part of one documented lot. What is the most defensible first QA response?
choices: Release the entire lot because most measurements were normal
Define the affected material and time window, preserve traceability, investigate cause, assess product impact and document disposition before corrective action is closed
Discard all historical records and restart the lot ID
Apply a corrective action immediately without determining scope
rationale: Deviation handling should first preserve identity and establish scope and impact. Corrective/preventive action is stronger when it follows documented investigation and includes effectiveness review.
